say:3:1520505002:1.text: Well, I've lost count. Your beloved Hunting Goddess has killed both Halians and Wildborn here.
say:3:1520505002:1.source_cn: 不计其数，有呼临人的，也有雅库伯尔人。多亏你们那位备受...
say:3:1520505002:1.male: Well, I've lost count. Your beloved Hunting Goddess has killed both Halians and Wildborn here.
say:3:1520505002:1.female: Well, I've lost count. Your beloved Hunting Goddess has killed both Halians and Wildborn here.

say:4:1520505003:0.text: The Halians are still busy cleaning up the battlefield. If we don't want a plague to break out, we'd better get rid of these bodies fast.
say:4:1520505003:0.source_cn: 呼临人还在打扫战场，这里只是临时停放，但这么多尸体不做...
say:4:1520505003:0.male: The Halians are still busy cleaning up the battlefield. If we don't want a plague to break out, we'd better get rid of these bodies fast.
say:4:1520505003:0.female: The Halians are still busy cleaning up the battlefield. If we don't want a plague to break out, we'd better get rid of these bodies fast.

say:5:1520505004:0.text: Hmph... famine, war, plague—such bad times for the people. I bet the God of Death's enjoying this somewhere in the shadows.
say:5:1520505004:0.source_cn: 哼……饥荒、战争，瘟疫，那位不知道躲在哪里的死神一定会...
say:5:1520505004:0.male: Hmph... famine, war, plague—such bad times for the people. I bet the God of Death's enjoying this somewhere in the shadows.
say:5:1520505004:0.female: Hmph... famine, war, plague—such bad times for the people. I bet the God of Death's enjoying this somewhere in the shadows.

say:6:1520505005:0.text: So, we have to deal with the bodies...
say:6:1520505005:0.source_cn: 所以，得想办法处理尸体……

say:7:1520505006:0.text: And we need to act fast, or the bodies will rot, and a plague will spread.
say:7:1520505006:0.source_cn: 而且要快。在挖完足够容纳的葬坑之前，尸体就会腐败，熬煮...
say:7:1520505006:0.male: And we need to act fast, or the bodies will rot, and a plague will spread.
say:7:1520505006:0.female: And we need to act fast, or the bodies will rot, and a plague will spread.

say:8:1520505007:0.text: To cremate the bodies, we'll need lots of tung oil and pine resin. I'm counting on you two to gather them.
say:8:1520505007:0.source_cn: ——火葬。但需要大量桐油和松脂，你们去想办法。
say:8:1520505007:0.male: To cremate the bodies, we'll need lots of tung oil and pine resin. I'm counting on you two to gather them.
say:8:1520505007:0.female: To cremate the bodies, we'll need lots of tung oil and pine resin. I'm counting on you two to gather them.

say:10:1520505008:0.text: Hey, I've been helping the Halians clean up the battlefield!
say:10:1520505008:0.source_cn: 你以为是谁在协助呼临人打扫战场？
say:10:1520505008:0.male: Hey, I've been helping the Halians clean up the battlefield!
say:10:1520505008:0.female: Hey, I've been helping the Halians clean up the battlefield!

say:12:1520505010:0.text: The souls of our warriors must rest in the embrace of the trees.
say:12:1520505010:0.source_cn: 但是，雅库伯尔战士的灵魂，只能在树木环抱中安歇。

say:13:1520505011:0.text: Oh? The Wildborn prefer tree burials? That's an interesting tradition.
say:13:1520505011:0.source_cn: 哦？雅库伯尔喜欢树葬？有意思的传统。

say:14:1520505012:0.text: Yes. Even though the Hunting Goddess has fallen, it's unthinkable to bury the warriors alongside their enemies.
say:14:1520505012:0.source_cn: 是。但是就算狩猎神大人……狩猎神，已经不在了。也不能让...

say:15:1520505013:0.text: It... would be a dishonor to their courage!
say:15:1520505013:0.source_cn: 这是……这是对他们英勇的玷污！

say:16:1520505014:0.text: Well said, but it's not my problem. I'm just trying to prevent more deaths. If you've got a better plan, I'm all ears.
say:16:1520505014:0.source_cn: 说得好。不过和我无关，我要做的是阻止更多人去死。除非你...

choice_prompt:17:1520505014.text: Well said, but it's not my problem. I'm just trying to prevent more deaths. If you've got a better plan, I'm all ears.
choice_prompt:17:1520505014.source_cn: 说得好。不过和我无关，我要做的是阻止更多人去死。除非你们拿出更好的方法。

say:20:1520505017:0.text: If I don't hear back from you soon, I'll just do it my way.
say:20:1520505017:0.source_cn: 但如果不快回话，我就按自己的方式来了。
say:20:1520505017:0.male: If I don't hear back from you soon, I'll just do it my way.
say:20:1520505017:0.female: If I don't hear back from you soon, I'll just do it my way.

choice:17:0:1.text: Let me ask Merlin for advice...
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 问问艾雅，不，问问梅林吧……

choice:17:0:1.female: Let me ask Merlin for advice...
